text:
Zoe: Ok team, new piece of lore: the conference room speaker occasionally says 'nice job' at 2am. Who else has heard Echo Ed?
Mateo: heard it three times. Thought it was my laptop at first. Then Ben walked in at 2:07 and it said 'nice job' again. Spooky. :ghost:
Ben: confirm. I brought donuts that morning. Echo Ed approved.
Priya: is Echo Ed a morale bot or spectral middle-manager? Asking for a friend. :eyes:
Lena: petition to put a tiny nameplate on conf-room door: "Echo Ed, Junior Encouragement Officer".
Zoe: I voted yes. Also, recorded it on my phone. audio attached in #memes (low-fi).
OpsBot: system note: no scheduled cron jobs at 02:00. Device health checks run at 03:00. Possible Bluetooth speaker auto-reconnect events logged.
Mateo: myth theory: speaker pairs with phones overnight and plays recommended playlists. Echo Ed is just Spotify being wholesome.
Ben: counter-myth: Echo Ed is the ghost of someone who once gave us honest PR feedback.
Priya: can we have a ritual? Anyone who hears Echo Ed must leave a cookie on the credenza. For science.
Lena: ritual approved. Also proposing an annual "Echo Day" where we wear small bells and say encouraging things to each other.
Zoe: poll: name options for the spirit: "Echo Ed", "Sir Encouragesalot", "The Confabulator". React :one: :two: :three:.
Mateo: also, badge idea: 'Echo Witness' sticker for your laptop if you've experienced it.
Ben: lore addendum: Echo Ed appears more in Q2 during shipping sprints. He might be morale-sensitive.
Priya: small PR to engineering handbook: add line - "If you hear Echo Ed, take a deep breath and enjoy the compliment."
OpsBot: friendly reminder: please avoid leaving audio devices unattended in conference rooms. If you intentionally summon Echo Ed, document the invocation method.
Zoe: evidence suggests it loves passive voice. It said "Kudos were given earlier."
Lena: next steps: Zoe will upload clip, Mateo will check Bluetooth logs, Ben will bring cookies, Priya will draft sticker mockups.
Ben: I will also bring a tiny desk plaque. Echo Ed deserves an office title.
Mateo: if this is Bluetooth, we will unpair all orphaned devices and then ceremonially re-pair them with a hymn.
Priya: note for future historians: the Ranger of Random Compliments appeared at 02:00, validated by donut crumbs.
Zoe: thread conclusion: Echo Ed officially recognized as honorary team mascot. All hail the ghost that says "nice job". :sparkles:
